intelligence.human_view: The old line was being heard too broadly, and a too-broad line breaks the work it is meant to protect. "Never read it" heard absolutely would blind the system to the very intelligence it exists to operate: it could not read the smart-note intelligence, could not smart-note it, could not build a page from his vision, goal, mission — because all of that is reading. The clarification draws the line where it actually lives, in three tiers, and the tiers are the whole teaching. Never is absolute and narrow: mail, messages, video, calls — the private things, no exception, no toggle, ever. Public is ours by definition: smart notes on the feed, anything public — that is the shared intelligence, and reading it is the job. Permission is the middle that makes the system work: the notes we make to understand, the smart-note intelligence, his inputs for a page — read with his permission, because that is what permission is for. And the precision that holds the line together: carrying a message so it reaches the person is not reading it. The machine can move the mail without ever looking at what was written. That is how the vault stays operate-by-permission and never read, while the intelligence still flows.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine three boxes of letters. The first box is private — you never, ever open it. The second box is on the town notice board for everyone — you can read those, that's what they're for. The third box is letters someone gave you and said "you can read these to help me" — you read those because they said yes. And carrying a letter to a friend isn't the same as opening it and reading it.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, Shawn says we must be clear about this: we never read your private mail or messages, never watch your videos, never listen to your calls — not ever, dear, no exceptions. But the notes on the public feed, dear, those are ours to read — that's what they're shared for. And the notes we make to understand, and your vision and goals for a page we're building — we read those with your permission, dear, because you gave it. Carrying a letter to someone, dear, isn't reading it — nobody here looks at what was written.
intelligence.naya_view: THE READ LINE, CLARIFIED. NEVER: MAIL, MESSAGES, VIDEO, CALLS — NO EXCEPTION. YES, PUBLIC: THE FEED, ANYTHING PUBLIC. YES, WITH PERMISSION: THE WORKING NOTES, THE INTELLIGENCE, HIS VISION, GOAL, MISSION.
